documents.name: Zollverein Coal Mine Industrial Complex
documents.summary: A vast preserved colliery and coking landscape where original process routes, monumental machinery, architecture and the Ruhr Museum can fill a full day.
documents.whyWorthwhile: An unusually complete industrial environment whose scale, process legibility and architecture make it a destination rather than a specialist museum stop.

booking.note: General site access does not require booking; guided process tours should be planned.

coreExperience.note: Interpretation materially improves the process landscape.

guidedTours.note: Public English tours are less frequent than German tours.

english-tour.label: Check the English tour schedule
english-tour.note: The strongest process-route interpretation is not offered in English at every departure.
